dex.entry: A sleek mid-stage gust-fox who now runs so fast it creates a visible bow-wave of compressed air ahead of it; close-combat opponents are pushed back by the pressure wave before it even strikes. The bow-wave around it makes the ground look like it's peeling back ahead of every sprint.

art.silhouette: Lithe medium fox silhouette, deep storm-blue body fading to pale silver at the throat and belly, a single bold tail crackling at the tip, wind-distortion ripples around the paws; pure velocity at 48px.
